releaseNotes:
## Contacts
- Added a People view with separate first and last names, and an expandable Families view.
- Added clickable column sorting, remembered sort choices, search, current/upcoming/no-email filters, sticky headers and pagination.
- Added family name and member editing, optional family labels, child ages and name-only contacts without required email addresses.
- Included normal bookings and conference attendance in visit history, distinguishing overnight stays and day visits.
- Improved individual profiles and family visit history while preserving original booking details.
- Required a review before merging contacts and prevented new-contact saves from overwriting an existing contact.

## Conference families
- Fixed family saves that were blocked by hidden contact-move confirmations or unnecessary email requirements.
- Reused the main member's existing family by default and made genuine move confirmations visible.
- Used consistent Family wording and preserved explicitly chosen participant contact links during contact sync.

Existing contact records and historical booking snapshots are preserved.
